entries.heading: Verse 1
entries.text: Ps 70:1-5 . This corresponds to Ps 40:13-17 with a very few variations, as "turn back" ( Ps 70:3 ) for "desolate," and "make haste unto me" ( Ps 70:5 ) for "thinketh upon me." It forms a suitable appendix to the preceding, and is called "a Psalm to bring to remembrance," as the thirty-eighth [see on Ps 38:1 , title].
